statement: ∀ n : ℕ, let P := (Finset.range (n+1)).filter Nat.Prime; let C := P.filter (fun p => 0<n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length≤2); let G := P.filter (fun p => (n-p).Prime); let S := P.filter (fun p => (Nat.sqrt (n-p)).Prime ∧ (Nat.sqrt (n-p))^2=n-p); let D := P.filter (fun p => ((Finset.Icc 2 n).filter (fun r => r.Prime ∧ ((Finset.Ioc r n).filter (fun v => v.Prime ∧ p+r*v=n)).Nonempty)).Nonempty); C.card = G.card + S.card + D.card + (if (n-1).Prime then 1 else 0)

brief.zh: 按余项 1、素数、素数平方和不同素因子的乘积分割。把定理 3 的无权总计数与 FR-8006、FR-8007 的平方损失接在同一归一化上。
brief.en: Partition the remainders into one, a prime, a prime square and a product of distinct primes. This connects the unweighted count in Theorem 3 to the square loss in FR-8006 and FR-8007.
